1084-4279-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-5931.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-5931.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2595-3967-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-3967-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-3967-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1621-3647.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-3647.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-7175-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-7175-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-7175-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

147-6798-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-6798-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1829-2173-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

573-1558-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-1887-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

305-1978-2750.description:
Cause Llanowar Tribe to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat from step 2.

4089-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Glasspool Mimic.
4089-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4089-4608-5466.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4785-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4785-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2692-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1550-4251-6633.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-6633.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-3334.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-3334.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

203-698-3152.easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
203-698-3152.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained 3 or more life this turn.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {W}.
203-698-3152.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {3} less.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve Anoint.
Repeat from step 2.

603-5470-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-5470-5686.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

586-997-2510-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-997-2510-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-2733-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
1170-2733-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1912-4131-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mishra's Warform's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2792-4313.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{R}{G}.
215-2792-4313.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{R}{G}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{R}{G}.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
When the token Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{R}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1020-1117-4659-5202.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Efficient Construction triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Efficient Construction triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

500-2239-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-2239-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ardent Elementalist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Ardent Elementalist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1912-4687.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
539-1912-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-1170-1749-4113-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least two additional creatures.
313-1170-1749-4113-4772.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and three other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.
